код: new Promise(res=>{const r=indexedDB.open("показ");r.onsuccess=()=>{const db=r.result;const names=[...db.objectStoreNames];const out={};const tx=db.transaction(names,"readonly");let left=names.length;names.forEach(n=>{const st=tx.objectStore(n);const q=st.getAll();const qk=st.getAllKeys();q.onsuccess=()=>{qk.onsuccess=()=>{out[n]=qk.result.map((k,i)=>[k,q.result[i]]);if(--left==0)res(out);};};});};})
